'''Yibikkoror''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Yinchorri system]]. It was a small world with a dense atmosphere and possibly no solid surface. The [[Yinchorri/Legends|Yinchorri]] built at least one [[Yibikkoror floating city|balloon city]] on the planet, and its residents used [[Yinchorri flutter-pack|flutter-packs]] for transportation. In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]] during the [[Yinchorri Uprising]], it was the site of the [[Mission to Yibikkoror|Battle of Yibikkoror]].
{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' names Yibikkoror as a moon of [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]], when [[Star Wars: Jedi Council: Acts of War|''Jedi Council: Acts of War'']] makes it clear it is a planet.
